name: Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon (33rd ed.)
short_description: The 33rd Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon takes place on September 27, 2026, in Pattaya, Chonburi, Thailand, with registration currently open.
ai_summary: The Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon is the 33rd edition of this annual race, scheduled for September 27, 2026, in Pattaya, Chonburi, Thailand. It offers four distance options: a full marathon (42.195 km), a half marathon (21.1 km), a 10 km race, and a 4.5 km race. Registration is currently open for runners interested in participating in any of these distances.
